info.title: Anime & Manga API for AniList (Unofficial): Scores, Genres, Studios
info.description:
Search anime by title and get AniList ID, romaji and English title, year, episode count, synopsis and page link as JSON. Up to 5 matches per call.

Sold on API.market: https://api.market/store/benthepythondev/anime-search-anilist (plans, free trial and API key). Call it through the API.market gateway with your API.market key in the x-api-market-key header.

post.description: Search anime on AniList by title and get each match as JSON: AniList ID, romaji and English title, season year, episode count, synopsis and the AniList page link. Up to 5 matches per request.

query.title: Anime query
query.description: Title keywords. Leave empty to browse by season, year or genre, most popular first.

season.title: Season (anime)
season.description: Only anime that aired in this season. Combine with Season year.

seasonYear.title: Season year
seasonYear.description: Year of the season, for example 2024.

genres.title: Genres
genres.description: Return only titles that have every one of these genres, for example ["Action", "Comedy"].

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Maximum records saved to the default dataset. A request returns 20 rows at most.

201.description: The results, one object per row.
